column1: # Files-list cases: the ONE set every files-list verdict is tested against
# app's in-screen list and its finish check; bin/rclone-backup `list`, whose
# load() is also what `validate` and `run` read).
#   kind   valid    the app accepts the list; `rclone-backup list` exits 0
#                   (in the C locale and in C.UTF-8);
#          invalid  the app refuses it; `rclone-backup list` exits 64 (both
#                   locales); an empty list (no entry) is invalid;
#          stricter the app refuses it, `rclone-backup list` in the C locale
#                   exits 0: a line the helper reads differently per locale
#                   (non-ASCII spaces, U+0085, U+2028), so the app never
#                   accepts what one locale would skip or refuse.
#   strip  the job's STRIP_PREFIX (a STRIP_PREFIX= line in its conf); "-" for
#   line   the lines of the files list, in order, each written with a final
#          LF; several fields make a list of several lines (duplicate copy
#          names). An empty field is a blank line. Escapes: \t tab, \r
#          carriage return, \\ backslash, \xHH one byte (UTF-8 for
# Lines starting with "#" (this header) are comments.
